blocks.text: Northwest homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Northwest, October 2026. Detached houses: 32 listed at month end and 5 sold in October, a sales ratio of 16% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 7 listed at month end and 1 sold in October, a sales ratio of 14%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 22 sold over 5 months against an average of 29.2 listed, about 6.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 7 sold. Condos and townhomes: 9 sold over 5 months against an average of 6.8 listed, about 3.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 3 sold.

faq.q: Is Northwest Maple Ridge the same as the board's "North" sub-area?
faq.a: No — they are separate rows in the same report. This page maps to "Northwest" (30 detached listings, 5 solds in September 2026); the "North" row recorded 0 listings and 0 solds, and the program's separate north-maple-ridge page does not map cleanly onto it — do not use "North" or "Northeast" figures for this page (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Northwest Maple Ridge?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 32 houses listed with 5 sold in the month and 7 condos and townhomes listed with 1 sold in the month in Northwest Maple Ridge. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Northwest Maple Ridge a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 16%, a balanced market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 14% on too few listings to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
